summary: High Tide Inc., a Canadian cannabis retailer, filed a Form 6-K with a news release providing preliminary Q3 2026 guidance. Management expects record revenue of C$195–200M, gross profit of C$51–53.5M, and adjusted EBITDA of C$15.2–16.5M, all above analyst consensus. The release also highlights a record quarterly distribution of over 10 tonnes of medical cannabis in Germany. No special-situation transaction, such as an acquisition, restructuring, or management change, is disclosed. This is routine operational guidance for a foreign private issuer.
